shots.prompt: The camera pushes in slowly toward the gate. Rain falls through the lantern light, and the woman in the doorway stands still with her spear against her shoulder.
The camera keeps moving toward the arch. The woman lowers her spear until its butt touches the wet stones, then straightens up and looks out into the rain.
The camera pushes closer to her face. She blinks slowly, her eyes move to the left, and a drop of rain runs down her cheek.
The camera holds close on her eyes. She blinks once, then again, and water falls from her lashes.
The camera tilts down to her hand. Her fingers tighten around the spear shaft once, then relax.
The camera turns slowly to the left, away from her, and looks down the road. Far away a man in a red coat walks toward the gate through the rain.
The camera holds steady. The man walks closer, one step after another, his coat swinging and his boots splashing in the puddles.
The camera tracks sideways as he walks. He stops, lifts his head, and looks up at the lantern above the gate.
